sents.t: On Wednesday morning, I wake up and I feel terrible.
My head hurts, my throat is sore, and I am very hot.
I call Mr. Lee.
“Sorry, I can’t come to work today. I am sick.”
Rosa brings me chicken soup.
She touches my head.
“You have a fever. You need a doctor.”
There is a clinic on Oak Street.
The nurse at the front desk gives me a form, and I wait for thirty minutes.
Then the doctor comes in.
Her name is Dr. Patel.
“What’s the problem?” she asks.
“I have a headache and a sore throat. And I am very tired.”
Dr. Patel checks my throat and my ears.
“You have a bad cold,” she says.
“Drink a lot of water and rest for two or three days. Take this medicine twice a day, after meals.”
At the pharmacy, I get my medicine.
At home, I go to bed with Rosa’s soup and my library book.
Rosa leaves Max with me, and he sleeps next to my bed.
He is a good nurse!

comp.q: What day does Sam feel sick?
How often does Sam take the medicine?

comp.q: Who sleeps next to Sam’s bed?
